Bereshit Rabbah 1:14

R. Akiva's et-hermeneutic (from Nachum Ish Gam Zu): akh/rak = exclusions, ET/gam = INCLUSIONS — "et ha-shamayim includes sun, moon, constellations; et ha-aretz includes trees, grasses, Gan Eden"; the chain's own rule-system for the particle our TIR-014/015 reads as Theme-inventory — evidence line for the TIR catalog + unit note candidate
Bereshit Rabbah 3:2

GRAMMAR: "not with toil… by the word; 've-haya or' (and light SHALL BE) is NOT written — rather VA-YEHI or (and light WAS): it already was" — chain-primary derivation from the wayyiqtol mood that the result is instantaneous-complete: grounds our RESULT latency-0 reading (sister to BR 3:7's seder-zemanim mood argument)
Bereshit Rabbah 3:6

opens "va-yiqra Elohim la-or yom — but the light is not the day?!" — chain-primary articulation that the naming write binds LABEL≠ENTITY (our REGISTRY semantics); continues: the primordial light serves neither day nor night — nignezah ("hidden") for the righteous = the BR half of or-ha-ganuz, now read and locally verified (complements the Chagigah 12a amendment)
Bereshit Rabbah 3:7

Bereshit Rabbah 3:9

THE mixed-series question, asked by the chain itself: "if counting — say echad, shenayim, shelosha OR rishon, sheni, shlishi; but ECHAD then SHENI?!" (cardinal then ordinals — exactly our LEDGER label_form [OPEN] flag) — answered: repaid at the Mishkan's dedication ("ba-yom ha-rishon… first to creation"); amendment candidate: cite on the echad note
Bereshit Rabbah 17:1

the TEN-UTTERANCES census (asarah ma'amarot, Avot 5:1) listed line by line: Gen 1:1 COUNTS as an utterance though va-yomer ("and [God] said") is absent — grounded on Ps 33:6 "by the word of the LORD the heavens were made"; so does Gen 1:2's ruach ("wind/spirit") per R. Yaakov ben Kurshai, while Menachem bar Yosei swaps it for Gen 2:18 — the chain's own enumeration of the speech-act operator inventory, with recorded dissent, bearing on whether e1 carries an implicit MAAMAR (utterance) operator; amendment candidate for gen_01 e1

the TEN THINGS CREATED ON DAY ONE, each with its verse: heaven+earth (1:1), tohu+vohu (1:2!), light+darkness (1:2-3), wind+water (1:2), length-of-day+length-of-night (1:5) — the Bavli counts our presupposed items (tohu, vohu, choshekh, ruach, mayim) as day-one CREATIONS: the direct counterweight to BR 1:9's found-materials challenge; amendment candidate for the NOTE_PRESUPPOSED note (both chain resolutions recorded side by side)

continuation of the or-ha-ganuz passage the unit cites: hidden FOR WHOM — the righteous, from Gen 1:4 tov ("good") = righteous (Isa 3:10); extends ORAL_or_haganuz with the tov=righteous derivation (cf. BR 12:6 row 33)
Chagigah 12a:20

R. Akiva transmits Nachum Ish Gam Zu's et-exposition on Gen 1:1: WITHOUT et, "shamayim" could be read as the Creator's NAME (agent) — et forces the created-OBJECT reading; the Bavli's et-rule as explicit agent/Theme disambiguation, exactly TIR-014's Theme-marker semantics; amendment candidate: Bavli partner quote for the BR 1:14 evidence line
Megillah 21b:10

the Bavli's ten-utterances count: nine va-yomer + "bereshit is also an utterance, as it is written 'by the word of the LORD were the heavens made' (Ps 33:6)" — Bavli witness for today's ORAL_e1_maamar amendment (BR 17:1, row 37)
Rosh Hashanah 32a:19

third ten-utterances witness, adding the architecture: bereshit = ONE utterance creating all matter at once, "after which all matter was formed into separate entities by the other nine" — e1 as bulk-create, later utterances as differentiation; extends ORAL_e1_maamar
Onkelos Genesis 1:1

the authorized translation's rulings on e1: be-reshit -> BE-KADMIN ("at first" — temporal, confirming TIME_ANCHOR against the misparse the Ptolemy change guards); et -> YAT, the explicit Aramaic accusative marker — the Targum rendering et as pure object/Theme marker (TIR-014's side of the et question); amendment candidate alongside BR 1:14 + Chagigah 12a:20

the yom polysemy formally SPLIT: the registry label becomes YEMAMA ("daytime") while the ledger unit stays yoma — u-kra YY li-nehora yemama… yoma chad; and the cardinal is preserved: yoma CHAD ("ONE day"), not ordinalized — the authorized translation keeping exactly the anomaly BR 3:9 flags; direct witness for the REGISTRY-vs-LEDGER distinction and the echad [OPEN] note; amendment candidate

teach.work: Bereshit Rabbah 3:7 (on va-yehi erev, 1:5)
teach.he: יהי ערב אין כתיב כאן אלא ויהי ערב — מכאן שהיה סדר זמנים קדם לכן
teach.tr: yehi erev ein ketiv kan ela VA-yehi erev — mi-kan she-hayah seder zemanim qodem lakhen
teach.en: "'Let there be evening' is not written — rather 'AND there WAS evening': from here, an order of times existed beforehand." R. Yehuda b. Simon reads the wayyiqtol (not jussive!) of the commit formula — the same mood distinction TIR-026 encodes.

teach.work: Or ha-ganuz (hidden primordial light) — Bavli Chagigah 12a (R. Elazar)
teach.he: אור שברא הקב"ה ביום ראשון אדם צופה בו מסוף העולם ועד סופו כיון שנסתכל הקב"ה בדור המבול ובדור הפלגה וראה שמעשיהם מקולקלים עמד וגנזו מהן
teach.tr: or she-bara HKB'H be-yom rishon adam tzofeh bo mi-sof ha-olam ve-ad sofo; keivan she-nistakel be-dor ha-mabul u-ve-dor ha-flagah ve-ra'ah she-ma'aseihem mequlqalim, amad u-genazo mehen
teach.en: "The light the Holy One created on day one (or = light) — a person could see by it from one end of the world to the other; when He beheld the generation of the Flood and the generation of the Dispersion and saw their deeds corrupt, He arose and hid it (genazo) from them."

teach.work: Ten utterances (asarah ma'amarot) — Mishnah Avot 5:1, enumerated at Bereshit Rabbah 17:1
teach.he: תְּנֵינַן בַּעֲשָׂרָה מַאֲמָרוֹת נִבְרָא הָעוֹלָם, וְאֵלּוּ הֵן: בְּרֵאשִׁית, וְרוּחַ אֱלֹהִים מְרַחֶפֶת, וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים יְהִי אוֹר…
teach.tr: teneinan ba-asarah ma'amarot nivra ha-olam, ve-elu hen: be-reshit, ve-ruach Elohim merachefet, va-yomer Elohim yehi or…
teach.en: "We learned: with TEN UTTERANCES the world was created, and these are they: 'be-reshit' (1:1), 'and the spirit of God hovered' (1:2), 'and God said let there be light' (1:3) …" — the chain's own census of the account's speech-act operators. It counts e1 (Gen 1:1) as an utterance although va-yomer ("and He said") is absent there — grounded on Ps 33:6 ("by the word of the LORD the heavens were made") — and records dissent: Menachem bar Yosei removes the ruach utterance and substitutes Gen 2:18; R. Yaakov ben Kurshai retains it.

teach.work: The et rule — Bereshit Rabbah 1:14, Bavli Chagigah 12a:20 (Nachum Ish Gam Zu via R. Akiva), Targum Onkelos Gen 1:1
teach.he: אִילּוּ נֶאֱמַר ״שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ״, הָיִיתִי אוֹמֵר: ״שָׁמַיִם״ — שְׁמוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא. עַכְשָׁיו שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר ״אֵת הַשָּׁמַיִם וְאֵת הָאָרֶץ״ — שָׁמַיִם מַמָּשׁ, אָרֶץ מַמָּשׁ
teach.tr: ilu ne'emar 'shamayim va-aretz', hayiti omer: shamayim — shemo shel HKB'H; akhshav she-ne'emar 'ET ha-shamayim VE-ET ha-aretz' — shamayim mamash, aretz mamash
teach.en: "Had it said 'shamayim va-aretz' (heavens and earth), I would have said shamayim is the NAME of the Holy One; now that it says ET ha-shamayim ve-ET ha-aretz — actual heavens, actual earth" (Chagigah 12a:20): et disambiguates Agent-name from created OBJECT. Sister rule at BR 1:14: "akhin ve-rakin mi'utin, ETIN ve-gamin RIBUYIN" — akh/rak exclude, et/gam INCLUDE ("et ha-shamayim includes sun, moon, constellations; et ha-aretz includes trees, grasses, Gan Eden"). And the Targum rules in the grammar itself: Onkelos renders et as YAT, the explicit Aramaic object marker ("be-kadmin bera YY YAT shemaya ve-YAT ar'a").

teach.work: The cardinal echad — Bereshit Rabbah 3:9, Targum Onkelos Gen 1:5
teach.he: לֹא הָיָה צָרִיךְ לְמֵימַר אֶלָּא אֶחָד שְׁנַיִם שְׁלֹשָׁה, אוֹ רִאשׁוֹן שֵׁנִי וּשְׁלִישִׁי. שֶׁמָּא אֶחָד, שֵׁנִי, שְׁלִישִׁי, אֶתְמְהָא
teach.tr: lo hayah tzarikh le-meimar ela echad shenayim shelosha, o rishon sheni u-shlishi; shema echad, sheni, shlishi — etmeha?!
teach.en: "It should have said only echad, shenayim, shelosha (one, two, three) OR rishon, sheni, shlishi (first, second, third) — but ECHAD then SHENI?!" (BR 3:9) — the chain itself asks our LEDGER's mixed-series question, and answers by deferred repayment at the Mishkan's dedication ("va-yehi ha-makriv ba-yom ha-RISHON… first to creation"). Onkelos preserves the anomaly in translation: "yoma CHAD" (ONE day, cardinal kept) — and splits the yom polysemy: the registry label is rendered YEMAMA ("daytime") while the ledger unit stays yoma.

teach.work: The presupposed materials — Bereshit Rabbah 1:9 vs Bavli Chagigah 12a:6
teach.he: צַיָּר גָּדוֹל הוּא אֱלֹהֵיכֶם, אֶלָּא שֶׁמָּצָא סַמְּמָנִים טוֹבִים — תֹּהוּ וָבֹהוּ וְחֹשֶׁךְ וְרוּחַ וּמַיִם וּתְהוֹמוֹת. אֲמַר לֵיהּ: כּוּלְּהוֹן כְּתִיב בָּהֶן בְּרִיאָה
teach.tr: tzayar gadol hu Eloheikhem, ela she-matza samemanim tovim — tohu va-vohu ve-choshekh ve-ruach u-mayim u-tehomot; amar leih: kulhon ketiv bahen beriah
teach.en: The philosopher to Rabban Gamliel: "a great painter is your God — but He FOUND good pigments: tohu, vohu, darkness, wind, water, deeps." Gamliel: "creation is written of ALL of them," answering item by item from later Scripture (darkness: Isa 45:7 yotzer or u-vore choshekh). The Bavli's parallel resolution (Chagigah 12a:6): TEN things were created on DAY ONE — heavens and earth, tohu and vohu, light AND DARKNESS, wind and water, the measure of day and the measure of night — each with its day-1 verse.

teach.work: Theme order carries no temporal claim — Mekhilta DeRabbi Yishmael, Pischa 1:4
teach.he: שׁוֹמֵעַ אֲנִי, כָּל הַקּוֹדֵם בַּמִּקְרָא הוּא קוֹדֵם בַּמַּעֲשֶׂה; כְּשֶׁהוּא אוֹמֵר בְּיוֹם עֲשׂוֹת ה׳ אֱלֹהִים אֶרֶץ וְשָׁמָיִם, מַגִּיד שֶׁשְּׁנֵיהֶם שְׁקוּלִין זֶה בָזֶה
teach.tr: shome'a ani, kol ha-kodem ba-mikra hu kodem ba-ma'aseh; k'she-hu omer 'be-yom asot H' Elohim eretz ve-shamayim', magid she-SHNEIHEM SHEKULIN zeh ba-zeh
teach.en: "I might hear that whatever precedes in the VERSE precedes in the DEED; when it says (Gen 2:4) 'on the day the LORD God made EARTH AND HEAVENS' [reversed], it tells you the two are equal to one another." Tannaitic ruling: surface order in e1's Theme list carries no temporal claim.

teach.work: Result is instantaneous-complete — Bereshit Rabbah 3:2
teach.he: לֹא בֶעָמָל לֹא בִיגִיעָה בָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא אֶת עוֹלָמוֹ, אֶלָּא בִּדְבַר ה׳ — וְהָיָה אוֹר אֵין כְּתִיב כָּאן אֶלָּא וַיְהִי אוֹר, כְּבָר הָיָה
teach.tr: lo ve-amal lo vi-ygi'ah bara HKB'H et olamo, ela bi-dvar H' — VE-HAYA or ein ketiv kan ela VA-YEHI or: kevar hayah
teach.en: "Not with toil nor labor did the Holy One create His world, but by the word of the LORD (Ps 33:6) — 've-haya or' (and light SHALL BE) is not written here, but VA-YEHI or (and light WAS): it already was."

teach.work: The naming write binds label, not identity — Bereshit Rabbah 3:6
teach.he: וַיִּקְרָא אֱלֹהִים לָאוֹר יוֹם — לֹא הוּא אוֹר וְלֹא הוּא יוֹם, אֶתְמְהָא
teach.tr: va-yiqra Elohim la-or yom — lo hu or ve-lo hu yom, etmeha?!
teach.en: "'And God called the light day' — but the light is not [the same as] the day?! " — the chain opens by articulating that the naming write binds a LABEL to an entity without collapsing them; it continues with the primordial light serving neither day nor night, hidden (nignezah) for the righteous.

gen_01_creation_boot.census: utterances #1 and #2 — the opening word itself counts (the day-one canon), then “let there be light.”

gen_02_raqia_day.t: Day two: firmament — build, divide, name; commit without test (1:6-8)
mat: Avot DeRabbi Natan, Recension B 36:2
the TEN UTTERANCES census names yehi raqia explicitly in the va-yomer list; R. Yirmiyah's taninim variant rides — the census claim on 1:6, tannaitic co-witness
Bamidbar Rabbah 12:4
'Shelomo — He who instituted PEACE between fire and water, combined them, and crafted the firmament: shamayim = esh + mayim' — the 1:8 name read as the settlement of opposites
Bereshit Rabbah 17:1

the census WITH its machloket: main count includes ruach (1:2) making raqia #4; Menachem bar Yosei removes ruach (raqia #3), R. Yaakov ben Kurshai keeps it — the ordinal of 1:6's utterance is dispute-relative
Bereshit Rabbah 1:3
ANGELS CREATED DAY 2 (R. Yochanan, from Ps 104:3-4 on our verses) vs day 5 (R. Chanina) — machloket; both agree none day 1 ('who was partner with Me?')
Bereshit Rabbah 4:1
'He roofed His world only with water' (Ps 104:3) — the firmament as WATER-ROOF, against the stone-roof way of kings — the DECLARE's architecture reading
Bereshit Rabbah 4:2

THE CONGEALING: the middle drop congealed -> lower + upper heavens; Rav: FLUID DAY 1, CONGEALED DAY 2 ('yehi raqia = let it harden'); fire from on High passed over and dried/burnished it; raqia as hammered lining (vayraku, Exod 39:3)
Bereshit Rabbah 4:3

MIDPOINT ('be-tokh = at the exact middle'); and the me-al derivation: 'it does not say ON the firmament but ABOVE it' -> THE UPPER WATERS ARE SUSPENDED BY THE WORD; like the flame in a lamp; their fruits are rain
Bereshit Rabbah 4:4
R. Meir and the Samaritan: the finger/tube demonstration defends the suspension empirically; R. Yochanan: the primordial waters split HALF to the firmament, HALF to the ocean (peleg/palga)
Bereshit Rabbah 4:5

the measures: dome-over-pool rain mechanics; firmament thickness machloket (sheet of metal / 2-3 fingers); RATIO MACHLOKET: upper waters exceed lower by THIRTY (lamed of la-mayim = 30, gematria) vs the Rabbis: half-and-half
Bereshit Rabbah 4:6

ben Zoma on 'made' vs the word (Ps 33:6); THE MISSING KI-TOV, four answers carried: Gehenna created on it; DIVISION created on it (R. Chanina; R. Tavyomei's a-fortiori: if division-for-good lost the tov, division-for-turmoil all the more so); water-work incomplete until day 3 (R. Shmuel bar Nachman — day 3's double tov); water's future penal career
Bereshit Rabbah 4:7
the NAME: shamayim = esh + mayim integrated (Rav); sa-mayim 'bearing water' (R. Yitzchak); shamim/assessing; the milk-and-rennet congealing figure — 'moist on day one, congealed on the second'
Chagigah 15a:4

the GAP between upper waters and firmament, four positions: a thread's thickness / boards of a bridge / two robes / two cups — and the ruach hovered day 1, division day 2 (the temporal boundary of our span)
Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:2:2

the ten-verse problem on OUR paragraph: Sunday = 1:1-5 + 1:6-8 = eight verses; the REPEAT vs SPLIT machloket (Cahana/Assi), the splitter cutting 1:8's va-yehi erev as its own verse — the tradition's own verse-arithmetic on the span
Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 1:1:2

yom sheni (1:8) probed for calendar counting and EXCLUDED: 'one makes no inferences from the Creation of the World — they are God's days, not human days' — a chain LIMIT on the COMMIT ordinal as legal precedent
Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:3:3

THE MONDAY FAST: 'On Monday they were fasting for TRAVELLERS AT SEA — God commanded: there shall be a spread in the midst of the water' — the ma'amadot key our verse to the sea's safety; same source owns day-4's me'erot reading (chain-primary of the fast cycle)
Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Bereshit 12:1

the angels machloket anchored ON 1:6 (R. Yochanan via Ps 104:3-4; R. Chanina day 5) — with the CONVERGENT rationale both hold: created only after creation began, 'so none can say they assisted' (Isa 44:24)
Midrash Tanchuma Buber, Bereshit 1:1
angels day-2 anchor again + R. YEHUDA vs R. NECHEMIAH: world created over six days vs ALL created day one — R. Yehuda's proof is the per-day VA-YEHI KHEN including our 1:7
Midrash Tehillim 119:25

'FOREVER YOUR WORD STANDS IN THE HEAVENS' — upon what do the heavens stand? UPON THE UTTERANCE 'let there be an expanse'; 'He commanded and it STOOD' (Ps 33:9) — the 1:6 ma'amar as the STANDING structural support of the firmament
Midrash Tehillim 148:1

'He established them forever, an ordinance that will not pass' — He said yehi raqia and FROM THAT DAY THEY DID NOT MOVE — the standing-ordinance reading; heavens-of-heavens carry the upper waters (1:8 cited)
Mishnah Ta'anit 4:3

THE CASE TABLE: Sunday reads 1:1-8, Monday reads 1:6-13 — our span is the cycle's overlap, read twice; 'a long passage by two, a short one by one' — the input->output rows anchoring the span's liturgical identity
Onkelos Genesis 1:6
translation observation: be-tokh rendered 'in the MIDDLE of the waters' — Onkelos writes BR 4:3's midpoint into the authorized translation
Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 4:1

the DAY-2 CREATION LIST: firmament, ANGELS, fire for flesh-and-blood, and THE FIRE OF GEHINNOM (co-witness to BR 4:6's Gehenna answer); WHICH raqia? R. Eliezer: the one above the Chayyot (Ezek 1:22) — not 1:1's heavens; 'were it not for that firmament the world would be engulfed'
Shemot Rabbah 30:13
'it does not say THE LORD said let there be a firmament, but GOD [Elohim]' — the agent name on our DECLARE read as the ATTRIBUTE OF JUSTICE, uniform through creation
Taanit 27b:10
the Bavli's arithmetic on OUR paragraph: yehi raqia read BY ONE 'as it is three verses' — the span's own verse-count derived in the reading law
Targum Jonathan on Genesis 1:7

the tradition INLINES the suspension mechanics into the verse: God made the expanse 'UPBEARING IT WITH THREE FINGERS between the confines of the heavens and the waters of the ocean' — the BR 4:4 finger figure written into the authorized-expansive translation
Vayikra Rabbah 36:1

HEAVENS-FIRST vs EARTH-FIRST (Beit Shammai / Beit Hillel) with the synthesis: 'regarding CREATION the heavens were first; regarding COMPLETION the earth was first' — day 2 as the heavens' COMPLETION event; R. Shimon b. Yochai: created together like a pot and its lid
kept: seven barren women <-> seven days; day 2 <-> Rebecca, the divider's day ('I will separate you', Lev 20:26) — homiletic correspondence

teach.work: Bereshit Rabbah 4:6 (on the missing ki-tov, 1:7)

Polarity DISPUTED, delta itself and the 3:17 linkage converged
Bereshit Rabbah 12:4

Nechemya of Kefar Sichon — three bases (earth day 1 / firmament day 2 / water day 3), each waits three days and delivers three products (day 3: trees, vegetation, Eden); R. Azarya's two-base variant (heavens→lights day 4, earth→man day 6). Day 3 = the earth's DELIVERY day in every model; model choice = recorded dispute
Chullin 60a:10

Shimon ben Yochai: created together like pan and cover; R. Eleazar b. R. Shimon: equivalent. The incubation arithmetic run BOTH ways — 1:11's day-3 sprouting stands in every model
Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 1:7:4

Preserved wobbles: the fronted perfects of 11:12/11:14 (ve-arpakhshad chaya, ve-shelach chaya — the two-row anomaly survives word order); the itam crux (u-nefaku IMHON, 'and they went out WITH THEM' — unresolved); 11:32's kol-less total (va-havo yomei terach — no 'all' in the Aramaic either); the doubled absence at 11:30 with the hapax kept as COGNATE (leit lah VELAD — the child-word survives translation as itself). ha-mabul ('the deluge') exits as tufana (the Aramaic flood-word) in the same verse-final seat. 11:28's father-idiom kept literal (al apei, 'upon the face of' — the buffer does NOT insert 'in the lifetime of'; the chain's gloss war stays outside the translation). Ur becomes Ura de-Khasdaei; moledet ('birthplace') becomes yaladuteih ('his birth'). The template stretch renders mechanically — begettings as oléd, the rows' rhythm intact; the plainest Aramaic since Gen 5, broken exactly where the Hebrew breaks.

gen_27_the_call.t: The call: go to the land I will show you (12:1-9)
mat: Avodah Zarah 9a:7

F — THE WORLD-ERA CLOCK: the two thousand years OF TORAH begin at OUR 12:5 "the souls they made in Haran" — the 6,000-year frame (desolation / Torah / Messiah) pinned to our verse; the tradition holds Abraham was FIFTY-TWO then — numeric claim, read open (guard 3)
Berakhot 55a:8
F — the cup-of-blessing law: one given a cup to bless who does not bless — the punishment-proof is OUR 12:3 "I will bless those who bless you"; live blessing law on our ink
Bereshit Rabbah 39:1

F — R. Yitzchak's BURNING BUILDING parable: Abraham inferred an owner for the world, and the owner looked out — "the Lord said to Abram" — the call as ANSWER to Abraham's inference; the Psalm 45:11 listen-daughter frame
Bereshit Rabbah 39:11

F — the 12:2 dossier: THREE GREATNESSES + FOUR BLESSINGS counted in the ink = three patriarchs + four matriarchs (R. Levi bar Chavyat); travel diminishes three things — procreation, means, name — and the verse's three promises repair each IN ORDER (R. Chiyya: a clause-to-clause machine); Abraham's COIN (elderly pair / young pair — the four coin-bearers census); R. Yudan: the Amida blessing fixed for him, and YOURS PRECEDES MINE — "Shield of Abraham" before "revives the dead"; the added-heh claim on hashamaima (15:5, feeds gen_31); avarekhekha = 248 by count; berakha read as berekha (pool — purifies the distant); the blessings HANDED OVER to Abraham
Bereshit Rabbah 39:12

F — He is more exacting for the righteous man's honor than His own: His own honored "by others" (I Samuel 2:30), Abraham's "I, Myself" (OUR 12:3 "I will curse"); the BOWING LAW censused here (bow at Patriarchs and thanksgiving, start and end; one who bows at every blessing is taught not to; High Priest / king grades) — live Amida law seated on venivrekhu; rains and dews by your merit
Bereshit Rabbah 39:13
F — Lot subordinate ("went WITH him"); the 75-YEARS arithmetic carried to Esther: Rav 40 / Shmuel 80 / the Rabbis 75 (Hadasa's count) — the redeemer-at-75 claim built on OUR 12:4's number
Bereshit Rabbah 39:14

F — "the souls they MADE in Haran" = the converts; whoever draws near and converts an idolater IS AS THOUGH HE CREATED HIM (the gnat argument); Abraham converted the men, SARAH the women (the plural asu carrying her agency)
Bereshit Rabbah 39:15

F — "the Canaanites were THEN in the land" = they still held right to it; the altar built only on the tidings of the Land (12:7); Beit El → Beit Aven proleptic renaming; INK: 12:8 OHOLOH WRITTEN WITH FINAL HEH — "he pitched HER tent": Sarah's tent first — the SAME ketiv class as Noah's ohaloh at 9:21 (gen_23 row 3) — cross-witnessed pair
Bereshit Rabbah 39:16

F — THREE ALTARS census (R. Elazar): tidings / acquisition / that-his-descendants-not-fall-at-Ai (Joshua 7:6 cashes it); vayikra = he made every mouth proclaim the Name, and = he began converting; 12:9 "journeying to the Negev" = charting toward the Temple site
Bereshit Rabbah 39:8

F — LEKH LEKHA TWICE, the recorded machloket: R. Yehuda — two departures (Aram Naharayim + Aram Nachor); R. Nechemya — one, plus the FLIGHT FROM BETWEEN THE PIECES BACK TO HARAN — the chronology-inversion claim (Genesis 15 BEFORE 12:4; Abraham 70 at the Pieces, 75 here, per Seder Olam) — feeds gen_31's ordering dispute; the permission claim (he did not leave until permitted); dew-of-youth (sins evaporate); R. Levi's weeding and hoeing scene ending at 12:7
Bereshit Rabbah 39:9

F — R. Yochanan's three-term parse of 12:1 (your district / your neighborhood / your father's household); the WITHHOLDING RULE: destination concealed to endear it and pay REWARD PER STRIDE — with its census (the land I will show you / one of the mountains / Jonah's proclamation / Ezekiel's valley); the two lekh-lekhas ranked — Moriah dearer
Bereshit Rabbah 40:2
F — the chastisement frame: famine confronted him AT DEPARTURE and he did not complain — "You instruct him from Your Torah" — the no-protest claim bridging our promise (12:2) to the descent (12:10)
Bereshit Rabbah 40:4

F — "now I know you are fair" resolved: travel diminishes, she retained; and the PRINCIPAL-BECOME-SUBORDINATE typology (Abraham with Barak/Deborah as the pair): 12:5 he took her → 12:13 "say you are my sister" → 12:16 "he benefitted Abram FOR HER SAKE" — a three-step arc in the ink
Bereshit Rabbah 41:3

F — silver-and-gold foreshadows the Exodus (Psalm 105:37); "on his journeys" = the same routes back — HE PAID HIS CREDIT DEBTS (R. Elazar ben R. Menachem); LOT'S FOUR BENEFITS census (12:4 / 13:5 / 14:16 / 19:29) against the four troubles, the sin recorded in four places, four prophets sealing the sentence — a fourfold ledger machine
Bereshit Rabbah 41:5

F — the muzzled-animals quarrel AT LAW: Abraham's beasts muzzled (theft!), Lot's not; the herdsmen's inheritance argument from OUR 12:7; God's ruling — "to your descendants" only when the seven nations are uprooted (15:16); "the Canaanites... then" = their right still stands (pairs with row 8)
Bereshit Rabbah 44:12

F — the ASTROLOGY-ANNULMENT dossier (15:5's hachutza): above the dome, habata is downward; "you are a prophet, not an astrologer"; the THREE THINGS that annul decrees (prayer, charity, repentance) + name-change, good deed, PLACE-CHANGE — the last from OUR 12:1 — + the fast; feeds gen_31
Bereshit Rabbah 49:9

F — the justice-argument dossier closing at OUR 12:1 (ten generations, only-with-you); Rav Ada's argument: the oath bars a water flood — A FLOOD OF FIRE evades it? (the gen_22 oath-scope machloket ARGUED BY ABRAHAM); INK: every tzadikim of Sodom WRITTEN WITHOUT YOD (inferior righteous) — defective-spelling claim read open (guard 3)
Chullin 49a:18
F — RULING-DERIVATION: R. Akiva's source that the BLESSERS OF ISRAEL ARE BLESSED (priests included) is OUR 12:3 (Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak) — priestly-blessing law on our ink
Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:6:3

F — the DEROGATORY-RENAMING LAW's sugya carries OUR 12:8 station: Beit El formerly, now Beit Aven — the idolatry-naming rule (call the eye of the cup the eye of the thorn) with the amida/amila exchange — our verse's geography inside the halakhic renaming machine
Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 5:2:4

F — THE DEW OATH: "when Abraham did My will I swore dew never departs from his descendants" (Psalm 110:3-4, the Abraham psalm); dew descends by NO creature's merit (vs rain, prayed down) — the dew/rain asymmetry in the liturgical law, granted at the call's reward complex
Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:3:1
F — THE MISHNAH at its JT seat: the blessings-and-curses location fixed BY GEZERAH SHAVAH from OUR 12:6 — elon Moreh here = Shechem there (middah II, the equal-cut named in the halakhah)
Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 7:3:4

F — the SAMARITAN FALSIFICATION charge: "you wrote 'Shechem' into your Torah beside the terebinths and gained nothing — you do not expound the equal cut; we do, from OUR 12:6" — a recorded rival-text variance adjudicated by our verse; R. Yishmael's fourteen-years rule rides the sugya
Mishnah Kiddushin 4:14

F — RULING: the Mishnah's closing testimony — ABRAHAM KEPT THE WHOLE TORAH BEFORE IT WAS GIVEN (Genesis 26:5), sealed with "Abraham was old... blessed with everything" — the pre-Sinai observance claim as a standing fact over the entity our unit boots
Mishnah Sotah 7:5

F — THE MISHNAH (the ruling over rows 34-35): the full ceremony case-table — six tribes on Gerizim, six on Ebal, the gezerah shavah from OUR 12:6 as the location source, the Torah on the stones IN SEVENTY LANGUAGES
Pesachim 117b:11

F — Reish Lakish maps 12:2's clauses onto the AMIDA'S FIRST BLESSING: "I will make you a great nation" = "God of Abraham"; "I will bless you" = "God of Isaac"; "I will make your name great" = "God of Jacob" — the verse's clause order structuring live liturgy (with the seal Shield-of-Abraham riding the adjacent segment)
Rosh Hashanah 16b:7

F — the Bavli seat of PLACE-CHANGE annulment: "and some say also change of place, as written lekh lekha... and after, I will make you a great nation" — WITH the recorded dissent: the other holds it was the MERIT OF THE LAND, not the move — dual-tracked
Sanhedrin 99b:12

F — Reish Lakish: WHOEVER TEACHES TORAH TO ANOTHER'S CHILD, the verse credits him AS THOUGH HE FORMED HIM — from OUR 12:5's "souls they made"; R. Elazar (as though he fashioned the Torah's words) and Rava's al-tikrei (fashioned himself) extending it
Sifrei Devarim 311:1

F — REGIME CHANGE AT THE CALL: before Abraham the world was judged by the measure of cruelty (flood drowned, tower dispersed, Sodom burned); FROM ABRAHAM, chastisements replace catastrophes — the proof is OUR 12:10's famine; the borders-of-the-peoples set by Israel's number
Sotah 38b:3
F — RULING-DERIVATION, second Bavli seat: ANY PRIEST WHO BLESSES IS BLESSED, one who does not is not (R. Yehoshua ben Levi) — from OUR 12:3; pairs with row 29's R. Akiva derivation
rows: Mekhilta DeRabbi Yishmael, Tractate Vayehi Beshalach 3:7

Bereshit Rabbah 40:6

Hoshaya's name): "go and pave the way before your descendants" — ELEVEN matched ink-pairs Abraham↔Israel: famine=famine (45:6), descended=descended (Numbers 20:15), to-sojourn=to-sojourn (47:4), severe=severe (43:1), hikriv=hikriv (Exodus 14:10), kill-me/keep-you-alive=cast-sons/keep-daughters (Exodus 1:22), yitav-li=vayeitev (Exodus 1:20), arrival=arrival (Exodus 1:1), wealth=silver-and-gold exit (Psalm 105:37), Pharaoh-commanded=Egypt-urged (Exodus 12:33), his-journeys=their-journeys (Numbers 33:1) — the typology machine over our whole span
Bereshit Rabbah 41:1
F — the palm-and-cedar frame closing on OUR 12:17: ONE NIGHT's taking → he and his household afflicted — whoever accosts Israel is repaid by their hand, Sarah the proof
Bereshit Rabbah 41:2

F — the afflictions dossier: RAATAN, the one disease that blocks relations — the measure exactly matching the crime; even the palace BEAMS stricken; Sarah prostrate all night ("Abraham left with a promise, I on faith; he outside the cage, I within it") — "all I do, I do for you"; the ANGEL WITH THE ROD acting at her word (al devar = by Sarai's word); and the NAMED GEZERAH SHAVAH al devar / al devar (12:17 ↔ 20:18) transferring leprosy↔obstruction between Pharaoh and Avimelekh — middah II on our ink
Bereshit Rabbah 51:6
F — Lot's remembered merit at 19:29 = his SILENCE here: he knew "she is my sister" (our plot) was cover and said nothing — our episode cashed a chapter later
Bereshit Rabbah 52:4
F — the CONSENT CONTRAST: in Egypt "PLEASE say" (12:13 — imri na, solicited); at Gerar he said it of her by force — our verse's na read as request; the seven names of the south on our negev route
Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 7:9:3

F — the raatan claim at its HALAKHIC seat: the compelled-divorce sugya (the Mishnah's list of conditions forcing divorce) carries "and with it wicked Pharaoh was stricken — as written, OUR 12:17"; attribution variance recorded (R. Shmuel bar Nachman in R. Yonatan's name here; anonymous in Bereshit Rabbah 41:2); the 24-cedars digression rides the number
Mekhilta DeRabbi Shimon Ben Yochai 3:1

F — [Hebrew read] "NO SLAVE OR MAIDSERVANT EVER WENT FREE FROM EGYPT EXCEPT HAGAR — as it is said (OUR 12:20): and they sent him away, him and his wife and all that was his" — the unique-release claim on our exit verse, seating Hagar's Egyptian origin (feeds gen_32) inside the thornbush sugya's Egypt-harshness claim
Sanhedrin 39b:21

F — INK-GRADED BEAUTY: Abishag "fair AD me'od" = up to but NOT including; Sarah (OUR 12:14) "me'od" itself — "she did not reach half of Sarah's beauty" (R. Chanina bar Pappa) — the exclusive-ad parse on our token
Sotah 46b:14

F — THE ESCORT LAW: for FOUR STEPS Pharaoh escorted Abraham (OUR 12:20 "commanded men concerning him") he was repaid four hundred years of his descendants' service (15:13) — measure-for-measure arithmetic on our verse; the standing escort rules (accompany four cubits in a city → no harm) ride it
Vayikra Rabbah 16:1

F — the seven-abominations leprosy census: "he who incites discord among brothers" = PHARAOH between Abraham and Sarah, proof OUR 12:17's vaynaga; R. Meir's count machloket (six and seven are THIRTEEN vs the Rabbis' seven) — counted claim, read open; the metzora = motzi-shem-ra etymology sealing it
Vayikra Rabbah 32:5

F — SARAH FENCED HERSELF in Egypt and all the women were fenced by her merit — the four-things redemption census (name, language, no slander, no licentiousness) with our episode as the female pole; the language leg cites 14:13 "Abram the Hebrew" (feeds gen_30)
Yevamot 13b:6

F — THE DIRECTIONAL-HEH RULE at its halakhic seat: R. Nechemya — a word needing lamed at its start takes HEH AT ITS END; the school of Rabbi Yishmael's census includes OUR mitzraima (12:10) — the grammar rule the unit's morphology already encodes, here with chain authority

teach.en: The span's translation witness — headline: THE BUFFER GIVES SARAI THE WORDS THE LETTER WITHHOLDS: 12:13 gains an instrument — 'that my soul may be PRESERVED BY YOUR WORDS' (be-fitgamaykhi): in the Hebrew her speech is demanded and never delivered; in the Aramaic her words are already the saving cause [find-class; dual-track, flagged]. The person-taking buffer holds through ALL THREE take-forms: va-tuqach -> ve-idabbarat ('she was LED'), va-eqach -> u-devarit ('I LED her'), qach -> devar ('LEAD [her]') — the lead-for-take policy gen_26 found at 11:31, now passive, confessional, and imperative. VA-LEKH -> IZEL: Pharaoh's go-word is the same Aramaic imperative Onkelos gave 12:1's lekh-lekha (izel lakh) — the letter's frozen-wall echo survives translation exactly. The expulsion SOFTENED: va-yeshalchu -> ve-ALVIU ('they ESCORTED/accompanied him') — the garden-stem's rhyme is buffered away into an honor guard. The plague DE-TACTILIZED: va-yenaga -> ve-aiti ('He BROUGHT plagues upon'), negaim -> makhtashin — the same Aramaic noun the law's buffer uses for nega [cross-buffer consistency]. NA ('please') -> khe-an ('now') both times — the corpus's first please vanishes in translation. raav -> kafna; kaved -> takif ('severe'); la-gur -> le-itotava ('to dwell').

Arakhin 16b:18
F — R. Yosei ben R. Chanina's alternate source: "on his journeys" — with the recorded practical difference between the two derivations (temporary lodging) — a two-source dispute on our ink
Bava Batra 100a:7

F — WALKING ACQUISITION at the Bavli: R. Eliezer's reason IS OUR 13:17 "arise, walk the land... for I will give it to you"; the Rabbis — love-of-Abraham, to ease his descendants' conquest — the kinyan machloket seated on our verse

Bava Kamma 93a:2
F — the PROVERB SOURCED: "drag wood after a property owner" — Rabba bar Mari's source is OUR 13:5 "Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks..." — folk-maxim rooted in our ink

Bereshit Rabbah 41:4

teach.en: The span's translation witness — HEADLINE: THE MEMRA DOUBLE-ENTRY. 15:1's anokhi magen lakh ('I am your shield') -> MEIMRI TEQOF LAKH ('My WORD is your STRENGTH'), and 15:6's ve-heemin ba-YHWH -> ve-hemin BE-MEIMRA da-YHWH ('he believed in the WORD of YHWH'): the buffer sets the Memra at BOTH ends of the faith-exchange — God's I becomes God's Word and the belief lands on the Word — in the chapter the letter itself frames as a word-event; and the genre is named outright: ba-machazeh -> BI-NEVUAH ('in PROPHECY') [find-class: theology-insertion, flagged]. SECOND: THE RITE LITURGIZED — qechah li ('take for Me') -> QAREV KODAMAI ('OFFER BEFORE Me') and va-yiqach-lo -> ve-qarev kodamohi ('he offered before Him'): the korban-verb two books before Leviticus, with the kodam-distancing on both command and compliance (gen_30's meshamesh-kodam family); AND the threefold read as THREE-OF-EACH (eglin telata, 'three calves...') — the menagerie 5 -> 11 [famous buffer arithmetic, dual-track]. THIRD: the 15:6 watch-point answered — ve-chashvah leih: the buffer KEEPS BOTH PRONOUNS BARE (declines to vote on the famous ambiguity — exactly its behavior at gen_30's tithe), while tzedaqah -> ZAKHU ('merit'): the same merit-root the buffer gave Noach's tzaddik (frozen gen_17's zakkai buffer) [repeat-policy]. REPEAT BUFFERS CONSISTENT WITH FROZEN RECORDS: seed -> sons (zarekha -> benakh/li-vnakh at 15:5, 15:13, 15:18 — gen_29's 13:15 buffer exactly); tardemah -> plain SHINTA ('sleep') — the SAME flattening gen_09 recorded at 2:21: both covenant sleeps lose their depth in Aramaic; rekhush -> QINYANA (gen_30's property-noun, now on the exodus wealth); Refaim -> GIBARAEI ('the mighty' — gen_30's 14:5 epithet verbatim); the identification class continues (ha-qeni -> SHALMAEI, the Kenite named as the Salmaean — gen_30's Salem-to-Jerusalem move on a new name). Also: ariri -> be-la VELAD ('without a child' — the gloss-fix vindicated); ben-mesheq -> BAR PARNASA ('the provision-steward' — the hapax resolved to an office); dameseq -> DAMASQAAH (the city turned gentilic — the wordplay resolved); mi-meekha -> bar DE-TOLID ('the son you will BEGET' — the body-idiom flattened); ba-tavekh -> BE-SHAVEH ('EQUALLY' — geometry to arithmetic); henah x2 SPLIT (haka 'here' / ad KEAN 'until now'); avon -> CHOVA ('debt' — iniquity as ledger); lo shalem -> la SHELIM (the sibling-skeleton kept); natati -> YEHAVIT (the perfect KEPT — the receipt survives translation); karat brit -> GEZAR QEYAM ('CUT a pact' — the cut-idiom SURVIVES in Aramaic here, where gen_22 recorded it dying at 9:11: the buffer's own covenant-idiom is cut-based) [delta vs frozen record, flagged].

teach.tr: ve-tzalliat bi-shma da-YHWH … qabil YHWH tzelotikh
teach.en: The span's translation witness — HEADLINE: THE PRAYER DOUBLE THAT UN-NAMES GOD. At 16:11 ki-shama YHWH el-onyekh ('for YHWH has HEARD your AFFLICTION') becomes arei QABIL YHWH TZELOTIKH ('YHWH has RECEIVED your PRAYER' — the affliction itself replaced by prayer), and at 16:13 va-tiqra shem-YHWH ('she CALLED THE NAME of YHWH') becomes VE-TZALLIAT BI-SHMA da-YHWH ('she PRAYED in the name of YHWH') — the tzali-family (frozen record: gen_27's call-as-prayer, gen_29's ve-tzali, gen_30's oath-in-prayer) fires TWICE in one chapter and DISSOLVES the corpus's only human-naming-of- God exactly where the machine registers it; her epithet is universalized (elaha de-chazei KHOLA, 'the God who sees ALL') and her hard reason-clause rebuilt as revelation ('have I even here begun to see, AFTER HE WAS REVEALED to me'); the well too loses the Name — 16:14 -> 'the well at which the ENDURING ANGEL APPEARED' [find-class: systematic un-naming, flagged]. SECOND: the PERE-ORACLE SOFTENED — pere adam -> MAROD BE-ENASHA ('a REBEL among men') and the hand-clauses turned economy ('he will be NEEDY of all, and the hands of men will be NEEDY of him') — the wild-ass domesticated to mutual commerce [dual-track]. REPEAT BUFFERS CONSISTENT WITH FROZEN RECORDS: 16:2's va-yishma le-qol -> VE-QABIL le-MEIMAR ('accepted the WORD') — the EXACT buffer frozen gen_11 recorded at 3:17: the two wife-listenings get one rendering; 16:3's va-tiqach -> U-DEVARAT ('she LED') — the lead-for-take policy (gen_26's 11:31, gen_28's triad, gen_30's dvar) now on Sarai; Qadesh -> REQAM (gen_30's 14:7 identification verbatim) with Shur AND Bered both mapped to CHAGRA (identification class; the Hagar-echo in the toponym is the buffer's); zarekh -> BENAYKHI ('your SONS' — the seed-to-sons policy, gen_29/gen_31, extended to the maid's line); the doubling KEPT (harbah arbeh -> asgaa asgei — the buffer preserves the inf-abs pair); ve-hitani -> ve-ISHTABEDI ('be enslaved' — submission hardened to servitude); chamasi -> DIN LI ALAKH ('I have a CASE against you') with yishpot -> yedin — grievance and demand harmonized into din-vocabulary; ariri-class concretions continue (ben-mesheq precedent): shifchah -> amta throughout.

mat: Bereshit Rabbah 64:8

F — THE WELLS ARE THE BOOKS: how many wells in Beersheba? — FOUR (R. Yehuda: the four wilderness banners) vs FIVE (the Rabbis: the five books of the Torah) — and the naming map laid out: ESEK ("involvement") = GENESIS (He involved Himself and created), SITNAH ("enmity") = EXODUS (the embittered lives), the LIVING-WATER well = LEVITICUS ("filled with many laws"), SHIVA ("seven") = NUMBERS — completing SEVEN books via BEN KAPPARA'S DIVISION (the traveling-Ark span, Numbers 10:35-36, A BOOK IN ITSELF, splitting Numbers into three) — and RECHOVOT ("expanses") = DEUTERONOMY ("when the LORD will expand") — the canon's own structure claim (seven books, the two-verse book) riding OUR well names [a canon-anatomy claim of the first order; the tradition mapping the Torah onto our block's geography]
Bereshit Rabbah 64:9

F — MI-GERAR read MEGORAR ("dragged/scraped"): robbers vandalizing his house all night, or BOILS (the Job scratching-verse) — the king arriving diminished; ACHUZAT MEREEHU disputed — a proper NAME (R. Yehuda) vs "a COHORT OF HIS FRIENDS" (R. Nechemya) [see O4 — Onkelos sides with the cohort]; PIKHOL disputed — a name vs "THE MOUTH (peh) THAT ALL HIS ARMIES KISS" — the title-parse's second seat (gen_36's claim, now at our 26:26)
Bereshit Rabbah 64:10

F — "RAK ('only') good" — THE RESTRICTIVE-PARTICLE inference on 26:29: their good was NOT complete (the canon's rak-exclusion rule fired by the chain itself); "we saw" = "your deeds AND your fathers' deeds"; and THE TEMPLE-DECREE STORY deployed as the verse's application — the empire decreed the Temple be rebuilt, the Samaritans schemed, the assembly wept at Beit Rimon, and R. YEHOSHUA BEN CHANANYA calmed them with the LION AND THE HERON ("it is enough that we entered this nation in peace and emerged in peace") — our covenant-in-peace verse the homily's charter; the did-they-find question answered from 26:19's living water
Bereshit Rabbah 65:1

F — THE SWINE EMPIRE simile at 26:34: as the pig lying down EXTENDS ITS HOOVES ("I am pure!"), so the empire robs while "arranging the courtroom" — and SO ESAU: forty years ensnaring married women, then at forty "likening himself to his father" ("Father married at forty — I will marry at forty") — piety theater as the marriage's motive; only Moses and Asaf publicized the pig-type
Bereshit Rabbah 65:2

F — terse: the destroy-them match frame — "let this one whose name is blotted marry that one whose name is blotted" (the Hittite wives under Deuteronomy 20:17's ban) — with R. Yehuda's matched-from-the-ends rule cited (even the unfit are matched); the marriage graded as ban-to-ban
Bereshit Rabbah 65:3

F — terse: the RAVEN-AND-STARLING kind-test story (R. Chiyya's roof test: "any bird that alights beside it is its kind" — "every raven after its kind," Leviticus 11:15) applied to the same match — LIKE GOES TO LIKE as a species-law analogy for the marriage
Bereshit Rabbah 67:11

F — (home seat 27:46, gen_47's span; first-anchored here via the wives of 26:34-35) Rebecca's LOATHING dramatized (Rav Huna's gesture reading); "like THESE" — striking this one and that one — the demonstrative counted against the standing wives [gen_47 carries the in-sitting credit]

mat: Bereshit Rabbah 65:5

Bereshit Rabbah 65:6

F — terse: the bribe a-fortiori — "if one who took a bribe from ONE WHO OWED HIM (a son's honor) dimmed, one who takes from a stranger all the more" — Exodus 23:8's blinding-clause cited [our law-corpus verse deployed backward into narrative]

Bereshit Rabbah 65:10

F — MERE'OT ("from seeing") tripled: from seeing THE WICKED ONE'S EVIL (the walk-out-in-the-market shame — minting "whoever raises a wicked son or student, his eyes dim," with Achiya-and-Yerovam the student case); from THE BINDING'S TEARS — the ministering angels wept and THEIR TEARS FELL INTO HIS EYES (gen_38's altar wired to our 27:1); from GAZING AT THE PRESENCE on the altar (the sealed-windows parable — the decree deferred to old age) [three-way recorded dispute]
Bereshit Rabbah 65:11

F — GADOL ("elder/great") DEFLATED: the puny-son parable ("if in your eyes he is tall, in ours puniest of the puny") — father and mother call him great, God: "in My eyes he is SMALL" (Obadiah's insignificant-among-nations); R. Berekhya's slaughterer-to-the-bull; and the SEVEN-ABOMINATIONS parse ("seven in his heart" → seventy, by the one-abomination-ten-sins scaling)
Bereshit Rabbah 65:12

F — THE PARENT-AGE DEATH-CONCERN RULE (R. Yehoshua ben Korcha): reaching one's parents' age — five years either side — one worries for death; ISAAC'S ARITHMETIC (123: within five of Sarah's 127) carried on our 27:2's "I know not the day of my death"; and the SEVEN HIDDEN THINGS census (death-day, consolation-day, depth of judgment, profit-source, another's heart, the fetus, the empire's fall) — each with its proof verse
Bereshit Rabbah 65:14

F — "go to the FLOCK" = advance the flock-nation (Ezekiel's sheep-of-My-pasture); TWO GOOD KIDS = FROM HER DOWRY — "so Isaac wrote her: two kids EACH DAY" (the marriage document's food clause cited as the taking's license!); TOVIM ("good") doubled — good FOR YOU (the blessings ride them) and good FOR YOUR SONS: "through them atonement comes on YOM KIPPUR" — the TWO GOATS of the atonement rite typologized from our 27:9 [cult-typology claim; testing-shelf contact at Leviticus 16]
Bereshit Rabbah 65:16

F — THE COVETED GARMENTS: Esau coveted them FROM NIMROD, killed him, and took them (the wicked-covets-the-prey verse) [closes gen_43 row 11's Nimrod pursuit]; Esau's ROYAL-GARMENTS father-service with RABBAN SHIMON BEN GAMLIEL'S CONFESSION ("all my days I attended my father — not one hundredth of Esau's attending") — the honoring-father claim at its strongest, from the chain's own mouth; WHY "WITH HER IN THE HOUSE" — he distrusted his wives ("he knew their deeds"; the scoundrels-and-scribe story)
Bereshit Rabbah 65:17

F — the SEWN HIDES (Jacob's arms like marble pillars — she sewed several skins); the miraculous-size testimony rows (the Festival camels, the cinnamon trees — "all miraculous acts"); THE ESCORT TO THE DOOR — "to here I was obligated to you; FROM HERE YOUR CREATOR WILL STAND FOR YOU" (the mother's-duty boundary line)
Bereshit Rabbah 65:18

F — THE EQUIVOCATION DEFENSE at 27:19: "ANOKHI ('I am') — destined to receive the Ten Commandments — but ESAU IS YOUR FIRSTBORN" (R. Levi's re-punctuation acquitting the sentence of lying) [see O-track: Onkelos renders it STRAIGHT — the buffer declines the defense; dual-track]; the ARISE-LANGUAGE LEDGER — Jacob's respectful "arise please, sit" repaid in "ARISE LORD" (Numbers 10:35), Esau's brusque "let my father arise" repaid in "GOD WILL ARISE, His enemies scatter" (Psalm 68) — speech-register as destiny
Bereshit Rabbah 65:20

F — THE VOICE-AND-HANDS MACHINE at 27:22: the wise voice vs the flaying hands; JACOB RULES ONLY BY HIS VOICE, ESAU ONLY BY HIS HANDS (the dominion split); R. Berekhya's toggle — when Jacob MURMURS (complaint), Esau's hands dominate ("the people complained... AMALEK CAME"), when he CRIES ALOUD they fail; AVNIMOS THE WEAVER'S test ("circulate their synagogues — if children's voices chirp, you cannot touch them"); and the Yerovam/Aviya dossier carrying THE TESTIMONY MISHNAH VERBATIM — "one testifies only on the face with the nose, and only within three days" (the widow-release identification law, Yevamot 120a) — quoted inside the aggadah (the narrative lore) [testing-shelf law surfacing mid-narrative]
Bereshit Rabbah 65:21

F — the voice SILENCES THE HEIGHTS: BE-OMDAM read BA-AM-DOM ("when the nation comes — silence"): WHEN ISRAEL RECITES THE SHEMA THE ANGELS FALL SILENT, then "Blessed is the glory" — the liturgy-precedence claim (Israel's praise before the angels'); the no-sitting-on-High rule (straight-legged, jointless); R. Yehuda bar Ilai's dark reading — the voice SCREAMS at what the hands did (Hadrian at Beitar) [dual-track: triumph and lament both recorded]
Bereshit Rabbah 65:22

F — "did not recognize him" = when the wicked stand from him he does not recognize him; "KISS ME" = THE BURIAL-ADJACENCY claim ("you will be beside me in burial — no other"); THE GARDEN ENTERED WITH JACOB (the goat-stench objection: nothing fouler — yet "the scent of my son": Eden came in with him; GEHENNA ENTERED WITH ESAU) [the entered-with pair, gen_34's pattern]; BEGADAV read BOGDAV ("his TRAITORS smell sweet") — the two repentance exhibits: YOSEF MESHITA (took the candelabrum, refused a second entry, sawed apart crying "woe that I angered my Creator") and YAKUM OF TZEROROT (mocked his crucified uncle, was pierced by the retort, executed HIMSELF by all four court deaths and preceded him to the Garden) — the traitor-fragrance doctrine with its martyr file
Bereshit Rabbah 65:23

F — terse: the scent shows THE TEMPLE BUILT, DESTROYED, AND REBUILT ("my son's scent" = standing; "scent of a field" = plowed Zion; "that the LORD blessed" = the future house) — the blessing verse as Temple-history in three clauses
Bereshit Rabbah 66:1
F — terse: the dew earned by TORAH-AS-WATER ("because I engaged in Torah likened to water, I merited dew") vs Job's open-doors merit — the merit map of the first blessing clause
Bereshit Rabbah 66:3

F — VE-YITEN ("and may He give"): the extra vav read GIVE AND GIVE AGAIIN — divine giving as repeatable op; the item-typologies: dew=MANNA, fat=THE WELL, grain/wine=the lads and maidens, or Zion/offerings/first-fruits/libations — and the summit: "dew of the heavens = SCRIPTURE, fat of the land = MISHNAH, grain = TALMUD, wine = AGGADAH (the narrative lore)" — THE TRADITION MAPPING ITS OWN FOUR-PART CANON ONTO OUR VERSE [the two-shelves architecture drawn by the chain itself, at the blessing]; Samson's divine-aid cash-in (Judges 16:28 remembering "may He give you")
Bereshit Rabbah 66:5

F — the DOOR GEOMETRY of 27:30 (the hinged double-door; Jacob behind the leaf as Esau entered — YATZO YATZA doubled = "seemed to go out and did not"); MITZEIDO ("from his hunt") = ARMED TO HUNT HIS LIFE — glossed by OUR LAW CORPUS: "asher lo tzadah" (Exodus 21:13, the manslayer's non-intent clause) — the law chapter's own hunting verb read back into the narrative [cross-corpus wire into the homicide machine]
Bereshit Rabbah 66:6

F — THE AMEN LAW at 27:29's blessing line: "an idolater who blesses the Name — ANSWER AMEN after him; one who blesses BY the Name — do not" (the taught rule), with R. Tanchuma's proof ("blessed shall you be more than all peoples") and R. YISHMAEL'S DOUBLE ANSWER (to the gentile who blessed him and the one who cursed him: "your response is already stated" — our verse both times) — a live liturgy law seated on our curse-and-bless clause
Bereshit Rabbah 66:7
F — terse: the SPIDER-HANDS merit ("by what merit does the spider [the empire] grasp? — those hands": Esau's delicacies-service); the yakum-repayment dup (row 11's second seat)
Bereshit Rabbah 67:1

F — terse: the TREMBLING PAIR — Ruth-and-Boaz beside Jacob-and-Isaac: "by right he should have cursed him/her — but the truster in the LORD is exalted: he BLESSED instead" — the snare-overridden rule at 27:33
Bereshit Rabbah 67:2

F — the trembling GREATER THAN THE ALTAR'S (R. Chama: "more than when he trembled on the altar" — gen_38 wired again); "WHO then" said toward REBECCA (the intermediary suspected); Gehenna entered (R. Yochanan: "does a man with two sons tremble? — Gehenna came in with Esau"); R. Acha's SEETHING WALLS with MI-EFO read "who is to be BAKED here?" (God: "neither you nor your son — HE WHO HUNTED game"); the ANGEL-UNTIED-THE-GAME claim (all day Esau trapped, an angel released — "the deceiver's prey does not scorch"); ATE MIKOL disputed — tasted everything created in the six days vs all the delights of the coming world; ESAU'S MEAT-CRY ("a bowl of lentils bought my birthright — you whom he fed MEAT, all the more"); Isaac's fear resolved BY ESAU'S OWN MOUTH ("he TOOK my birthright" → "I blessed RIGHTLY"); and THE RATIFICATION MAXIM — "a deed is ratified only by its signatories: lest you say the blessings stood only by deceit — the verse states GAM BARUCH YIHYEH ('indeed he shall be blessed')" [the signatories law, second seat]
Bereshit Rabbah 67:3

F — the CURSE GUARD: Isaac moved to curse Jacob and was stopped by his own words ("cursed be one who curses you — you would curse YOURSELF"); R. Levi's SIX ORGANS rule — three in one's control (mouth, hand, foot), three not (eye, ear, nose) — and WHEN ONE MERITS, GOD FLIPS THE CONTROLLED TO UNCONTROLLED (the shriveled hand; OUR "indeed he shall be blessed" as the mouth's case) [an agency model with our verse as its mouth exhibit]
Bereshit Rabbah 67:4

F — GOD IS NOT LAX ("whoever says the Holy One is lax — may his innards be lax; He is PATIENT AND COLLECTS"): THE CRY-FOR-CRY LEDGER — Esau's one great bitter cry at OUR 27:34 repaid at MORDECHAI'S "great and bitter cry" (Esther 4:1) — measure-for-measure across the canon at the exact phrase; BE-MIRMA re-graded "WITH THE WISDOM OF HIS TORAH" (R. Yochanan) [see O-track: Onkelos renders the SAME — with wisdom; double-witnessed]; Reish Lakish's throat-clearing parse of hakhi; "reserved a blessing" = from the INFERIOR ones
Bereshit Rabbah 67:5

F — WHY THE SEVENTH BLESSING FIRST ("behold, I have placed him lord to you"): "I made him KING over you — and your blessings are HIS: THE SLAVE — WHATEVER HE OWNS BELONGS TO HIS MASTER" — the acquisition maxim (the goring-ox corpus's own slave-property rule) deployed to void Esau's claim [testing-shelf maxim as narrative logic]; LEKHA EFO parsed (your bread is BAKED / "the oven bakes for you everywhere" / EFO = af-ve-chema, "fury and wrath," the acronym); and the ISAAC-GOD DIALOGUE on Esau's plea — "grant him grace" / "he is wicked" / "did he not honor his parents?" / "he will raid the Temple" / "then tranquility NOW and no share in the majesty later" [the this-world-settlement claim]
Bereshit Rabbah 67:6

F — terse: fat-of-the-earth identified — ITALY and Beit Guvrin (Esau's geography); the Antoninus radish-counsel story (uproot the great, plant the small — the tax-counsel by demonstration) at "the fat ones of the earth"
Bereshit Rabbah 67:7

F — VE-AL CHARBEKHA ("by your sword"): R. Levi reads UL ("SHEATHE") — "sheathe your sword and you will live"; TAAVOD/TE'ABED — "if he merits, you will SERVE; if not, you will ERADICATE" (Rav Huna's double-read); TARID ("you will revolt") = the YOKE-REMOVAL CONDITION — R. Yosei bar Chalafta: "when you see your brother THROW OFF THE YOKE OF TORAH, decree persecutions and you will dominate" (with the Isaiah 63:16 where-is-Isaac sting) [see O-track: Onkelos WRITES THIS CONDITION INTO THE VERSE — the sweep's largest convergence]
Bereshit Rabbah 67:13

F — (home 28:8-9, gen_47's span; first-anchored here) ESAU'S HALF-REPENTANCE: "he considered converting" (R. Yehoshua ben Levi); MACHALAT = "GOD FORGAVE (machal) HIM his iniquities" — the wedding-forgiveness claim carried on the bride's name; but "IN ADDITION to his wives" — pain upon pain, thorn upon thorn ("had he divorced the first ones it would have been right") — the repentance graded incomplete on the verse's own preposition
Bereshit Rabbah 75:8

F — THE COUNTERSIGNED BLESSINGS TABLE: every clause Isaac blessed below, the Holy One blessed above with its matching verse (dew↔Micah's dew; fat↔the rain verse; peoples-serve↔kings-your-caregivers; lord-to-brethren↔uppermost-over-nations) — the blessing as a ratified two-signature instrument; REBECCA'S BLESSING (Psalm 91's angels-charge) answered by the Spirit; and WHY BLESSED AGAIN AT 28:1 — "Isaac saw the exiles coming and blessed him THE BLESSINGS OF EXILE" (the Job six-troubles verses) [wires gen_47's summons]
Bereshit Rabbah 76:6

F — JACOB ARGUES FROM LAW: "lest he smite me, MOTHER WITH CHILDREN" — held against "you shall not take THE MOTHER WITH THE OFFSPRING" (Deuteronomy 22:6, the nest law) AND "it and its offspring you shall not slaughter IN ONE DAY" (Leviticus 22:28) — Esau's threat measured against the Torah's own mercy statutes [the prayer citing the law corpus; and the horns dossier of the small horn on the Esau periphery]
Bereshit Rabbah 91:11

F — terse: THE EFO REPAYMENT — Jacob's later "if so then (efo)..." trembling read against OUR 27:33's "who then (efo)": "can the trembling I caused my father be shaking ME here?" — the measure-for-measure wire at the exact particle
Bereshit Rabbah 98:6
F — terse: the WIVES-COUNT RULE double-witnessed — Isaac (one wife) says "your MOTHER'S sons," Jacob (four) says "your FATHER'S sons" (49:8 vs our 27:29) — the phrasing law confirmed from both seats
Bereshit Rabbah 99:5

F — THE END CONCEALED: Isaac sought to BLESS ESAU AND REVEAL THE END — "the Holy One stripped his sense... he began trembling... found nothing to say but GAM BARUCH YIHYEH" — the trembling re-explained as the concealment moment (the removes-speech-from-the-trusted verse; Jacob's own 49:1 concealment the pair) [dual-track with rows 22-23's Gehenna reading]
Bereshit Rabbah 99:7

F — terse: WEAPONS OF VILLAINY ARE ESAU'S — Simeon and Levi rebuked because the sword "is not yours — it is Esau's, of whom it is written BY YOUR SWORD YOU SHALL LIVE (our 27:40)" — our verse as the sword's title-deed in Jacob's rebuke

gen_47_grudge_flight_paddan_send.t: Esau's grudge, Jacob's flight order, Rivqah's pressure — Paddan send (27:41-28:9)
mat: Bereshit Rabbah 67:9

F — WHO TOLD REBECCA? (27:42's "were told" with no teller) — THE MATRIARCHS WERE PROPHETS, and Rebecca among them (R. Chagai via R. Yitzchak), with the furrow-in-furrow argument (a prophet does not plow a furrow into a furrow — her plan carried foreknowledge) [the doctrine Onkelos wrote into 27:13 — see gen_46 O1: the insert's source row]; MITNACHEM parsed as THE CUP OF CONSOLATION — "he has ALREADY DRUNK the mourner's cup over you" (killing you is settled in his mind) [see O1 — Onkelos renders AMBUSH instead: dual-track on one word]
Bereshit Rabbah 67:10

F — YAMIM ACHADIM ("a few days") DECODED BY VERBAL ANALOGY: achadim here and achadim at 29:20 ("he worked seven years... like a few days") — AS THERE SEVEN YEARS, SO HERE SEVEN YEARS (R. Chanina bar Pazi) — the mother's vague "few" made a term of years by the canon's own equation [the analogy inference named; the exile's first clock]; her "until his anger subsides" held against Amos's ink — "his wrath he kept FOREVER" (the subsiding never came; Reish Lakish: it never left his mouth)
Bereshit Rabbah 68:5

F — THE FLIGHT ARITHMETIC (Chizkiya): Jacob SIXTY-THREE at the blessing [credit 62:4's number] + FOURTEEN YEARS HIDDEN IN THE HOUSE OF EVER (the untold study years between our verses) + seven worked = MARRIED AT EIGHTY-FOUR — "He delays for the righteous and advances the wicked" (Esau at forty); and R. Hoshaya's WHY-SAY-DEPARTED — Jacob went first TO BEERSHEBA FOR PERMISSION ("where did Father seek leave to go abroad? — I too") — departure as licensed act
Bereshit Rabbah 70:17

F — terse: THE FRAUD-PROOF CONTRACT — "I will work for RACHEL, YOUR DAUGHTER, THE YOUNGER" — three specifications because "I know your townsmen are deceivers": not Leah, not a market-Rachel, no name-swap ("even in a carpenter's vise the wicked avails you nothing") — the anti-deceit drafting rule [the charlatan dossier of 25:20 cashing as contract law]; the achadim analogy's second seat
Bereshit Rabbah 75:9

F — THE MUZZLE PRAYER ("do not grant the wicked's desires — make him a MUZZLE": Barbary and Germany the empire's muzzle, R. Chama); THE SAID-IN-HEART CENSUS (Esau, Yerovam, Haman — the three who plotted in the heart and failed) [credit 34:10's list, the census's own row]; and ESAU'S CAIN CALCULUS decoded from OUR 27:41 — "Cain killed his brother and God did nothing; the father lived and begot heirs. I WILL KILL MY FATHER FIRST, THEN JACOB, AND INHERIT ALONE" ("let the days of mourning APPROACH" = let me hasten them) — the plan's full logic recorded, and thwarted
Bereshit Rabbah 76:2

F — the camp recounted: 2,000 myriads (Psalm 68:18's chariots), FOUR thousand myriads given Jacob, appearing as a king's armies — iron-clad, cavalry, chariots — each column interrogated by Esau ("whose are you?" — "Jacob's"); the king's-dish parable ("he knows the king — I cannot touch him"): the God-name spoken to frighten [the escort as deterrent display]
Bereshit Rabbah 75:11

F — why send at all? MAYBE HE WILL REPENT; the message decoded ("not as he left — all this is MY WAGES, my effort"); and THE EIGHT-ADONI PENALTY: Jacob called Esau "my lord" EIGHT TIMES — "as you live, I will establish EIGHT KINGS from his sons before yours" (36:31 cited) [the deference priced in dynasties — CASHED at gen_59's king-ledger]; peace-or-war readiness; David's foundation-of-the-world psalm
Bereshit Rabbah 75:12

Bereshit Rabbah 75:13

F — THE LEVITICUS PLEA: Jacob argues from the not-yet-given law — "You wrote: IT AND ITS OFFSPRING YOU SHALL NOT SLAUGHTER ON ONE DAY (Leviticus 22:28); if this wicked one destroys mother and children together — WHO WILL READ THE TORAH SCROLL YOU ARE DESTINED TO GIVE?" [the statute cited as prayer's lever before Sinai — the block's boldest law-wire]; the gift as EYE-BLINDING BRIBE (Deuteronomy 16:19 applied — "the wise are the Edomites"); and "put SPACE between drove and drove" = "Master of the universe: if troubles come upon my children, SPACE THEM — not one after another" [the gap-between-calamities prayer, a standing intercession]
Bereshit Rabbah 75:2

Bereshit Rabbah 75:3
F — terse: the audit's second seat — the sleeping-robber parable ("I was asleep and you WOKE me"); Jeremiah 13:21 "you trained them as chieftains over you"
Bereshit Rabbah 75:5

[the verse as court protocol]; "I resided with LABAN — the master of deceivers, and kept him up my sleeve: this man all the more so"; and the delay explained: the ADVERSARY had not yet been born — the Rachel's-descendants tradition (third seat)
Bereshit Rabbah 75:6

F — shor/ḥamor three ways: many-from-one; the vernacular; the Rabbis — shor = the WAR-ANOINTED, ḥamor = THE MESSIANIC KING ("humble, riding upon a donkey," Zechariah 9:9) [the gift-list carrying the end of days]; flock = Israel; the slaves'-eyes psalm

F — "we came to your BROTHER, to ESAU": you treat him as a brother, HE TREATS YOU AS ESAU [the double-name decoded as the mission's verdict]; the four hundred each worth four hundred men (Reish Lakish); R. Levi: the tax-license plot ("if I cannot beat him I will demand the toll — and kill him in the collecting")
Bereshit Rabbah 76:3

F — THE ASSET-SPLIT LAW: "the Torah taught you proper conduct — a man should not put ALL HIS WEALTH IN ONE CORNER" — derived from OUR va-yaḥatz (Ovadya's fifty-per-cave the second case) [a standing prudence rule minted here]; the two camps decoded: our brethren in the SOUTH and our brethren in the DIASPORA — "though they survived, they fast for us Mondays and Thursdays"
Bereshit Rabbah 76:4

F — "God of my father Abraham and of my father Isaac" — AND NOT OF ESAU: the PRESENCE-BY-CONDUCT rule ("one who chooses their path, I rest My name on him; one who does not — I do not"), the Aḥaz-skipped/Hezekiah-named proof [sonship insufficient; conduct decides the invocation]
Bereshit Rabbah 76:5

Levi) [the merit-depletion doctrine; Onkelos votes with depletion — O2]; the JORDAN-BY-JACOB'S-MERIT rule (Torah/Prophets/Writings proofs — Israel crossed only by his crossing); the hot-springs escape (Esau locked him into the Tiberias "Jordan"; God dug him a new outlet — Isaiah 43:2)
Bereshit Rabbah 76:8

F — the THREE-QUESTIONS DRILL: Rabbi and R. Yosei ben R. Yehuda pre-rehearsing the gentile's questions on the road — "from where do you have this? FROM JACOB OUR PATRIARCH" (the briefed messengers of 32:18-20 as the precedent for coordinated testimony); "when you find him IN HIS GREATNESS" (the approach varies with his state); the droves spaced to SATIATE THE WICKED EYE ("he came to finish and the servant said RECEIVE, and again RECEIVE"); "the gift passed before his face" — HE TOO WAS DISTRESSED
Bereshit Rabbah 76:9

F — DINA IN THE CHEST: Jacob locked her in against Esau's covetous eye — and THE CHARGE: "you withheld kindness from your brother — had she married him she would not have gone astray; you refused the circumcised, she married the UNCIRCUMCISED; refused the permitted way, she was taken the forbidden way — therefore VA-TETZE DINA" (Job 6:14 pressed) [the hidden-daughter accusation: the chain blaming the precaution for ch 34 — wires gen_57]; the bridge-himself crossing (took from here, set down there)
Bereshit Rabbah 77:1

Yeshurun — the righteous do FIRST what God will do in the future: ELIJAH revives the dead, withholds rain, blesses the scarce; ELISHA doubles the list (revives, remembers the barren, sweetens bitter WITH bitter) [the anticipation table — Elijah-docket exhibit]; "the LORD ALONE will be exalted" ↔ "Jacob remained ALONE" [the solitude twinned]
Bereshit Rabbah 77:2

F — the adversary NAMED: ESAU'S GUARDIAN ANGEL (R. Ḥama — hence "I have seen your face AS THE FACE OF ANGELS," 33:10); the athlete-and-king parable ("he saw IN THE PRESENCE that he could not prevail"); WHO WON? — R. Berekhya: "WE DO NOT KNOW — but who was filled with dust? THE MAN WITH HIM" [the chain's honest uncertainty, decided by the dust of the verb]; the FIVE AMULETS (his merit, father's, mother's, grandfather's, grandmother's — "measure yourself against even HIS alone"); the wild-dog/tame-lion parable ("your ANGEL could not stand against him — and you seek his children?"); "touched the hollow of his thigh" = TOUCHED THE RIGHTEOUS DESTINED FROM HIM — the GENERATION OF THE PERSECUTION [the wound is future history]; the dislocation verb tri-parsed (driven-in / SPLIT LIKE A FISH / dislodged); shield on shield till dawn
Bereshit Rabbah 78:1

F — "release me, FOR DAWN HAS RISEN": the NEW-ANGELS-EACH-DAY doctrine (no heavenly cohort sings twice; God creates a new company daily — Michael and Gabriel the standing exceptions); R. Berekhya's objection FROM OUR VERSE and R. Ḥelbo's answer; the HADRIAN interrogation (where do they go? whence created? THE RIVER OF FIRE — flowing from the SWEAT OF THE BEASTS bearing the Throne; the Jordan-by-Peor rebuttal); and the RANK TRIPLE derived here: the GUARDED outranks the guard, the CARRIED outranks the carrier, THE RELEASER OUTRANKS THE RELEASED (R. Shimon, from OUR shalḥeni) [a standing inference table with our verse as its third leg]
Bereshit Rabbah 78:2

F — the angel's plea: "my turn to sing has come — miss it and they bar me tomorrow"; Jacob's retort TWICE: "complete your task, take your reward — I will not release you unless you bless me"; the angel's fear: the Sodom angels were BANISHED 138 YEARS for revealing the secret ("shall I be banished from my partition?") [the 138 number RE-SEATED in the angel's own mouth — gen_48 credit 50:9's figure]; Rav Huna: he resolved to reveal it with a defense ready ("Your prophets decree and You do not annul — could I annul theirs?"); the DEFERRAL: "He will reveal Himself to you at BEIT EL and change your name — AND I WILL BE STANDING THERE" (Hosea 12:5 "there He will speak WITH US") [wires gen_58's renaming]
Bereshit Rabbah 78:4

F — "why do you ask my name?" — THE MUTABLE-NAMES DOCTRINE: the stars' two verses reconciled (names change — "not as he is called now is he called later"); Judges 13:18's peli: "I DO NOT KNOW WHAT NAME I WILL BE EXCHANGED TO" [the messenger class has no fixed name — beside the name Jacob is about to have FIXED]
Bereshit Rabbah 78:5

F — "the sun rose FOR HIM": for whom did it not? — FOR HIM MEANS FOR HIS HEALING (for the world, light); the sun healing Jacob while SCORCHING Esau and his chieftains — you-are-a-sign-for-your-children (Malachi 3:20 healing / 3:19 furnace, both ways) [the Vayetze debt repaid with interest — credit 68:10]; R. Yehoshua ben Levi limping at Akko — "you are like your ancestor"
Bereshit Rabbah 78:6

F — THE SCIATIC-NERVE LAW at its birth verse (32:33): named gid ha-nashe from the DISLOCATION (nasha = displaced); Rav Huna: the nerve's outer extensions are TECHNICALLY PERMITTED — "but Israel is holy and prohibited them upon themselves" [the self-stringency claim recorded]; the WHICH-LEG dispute: R. Yehuda — he touched ONE and ONE is prohibited (logic: the right); R. Yosei — he touched one and BOTH are prohibited (the verse names no side), each with a logic-dictates tradition [the first food-prohibition tied to narrative; testing-shelf wire to the recorded nerve chapter]
Bereshit Rabbah 78:11

F — the NIGHT COMPANIES: angel troops beating Esau's men all night — "whose are you?" "Esau's" — STRIKE; "Abraham's grandson" — strike; "Isaac's son" — strike; "we are JACOB'S BROTHER'S" — "leave them, they are OURS" [the brother-title as the only password]; morning: "whose is that whole camp I met?" — "I have plenty — OF BEATINGS"; and THE RATIFICATION: the blessings sat DUBIOUS in his hand until "my brother, WHAT IS YOURS SHALL BE YOURS" — R. Elazar's maxim re-minted: RATIFICATION OF A DOCUMENT IS ONLY BY ITS SIGNATORIES [the gen_47 maxim's second seat, at the meeting itself]
Bereshit Rabbah 79:5

Yoḥanan — but Joseph forgot, "God made me forget my toil") [the intact-claim tested clause by clause; numeric rider]

gen_56_blessing_returned_first_altar.t: The blessing returned and the first altar (33:1-20)
mat: Bereshit Rabbah 78:7

F — the FOX-AND-LION placation: the fox's three hundred parables forgotten a hundred at a time until "let each placate for itself" — so Jacob: "I can pray" / "I can wage war" (the two capability claims), but at the sight he DIVIDED THE CHILDREN — "let each one's merit stand for him" [merit individuated at the crisis; the collective shield disaggregated]
Bereshit Rabbah 78:9

F — THE DOTTED KISS at its home (33:4): va-yishakehu carries scribal DOTS — R. Shimon ben Elazar's rule applied (script over dots / dots over script — expound the majority; HERE THEY ARE EQUAL, the rule's hard case): either he kissed WITH ALL HIS HEART (the mercy reading) or — R. Yannai — he came TO BITE, and Jacob's neck TURNED TO MARBLE and the wicked one's teeth were BLUNTED; "and they wept" — this one over his neck, that one over his teeth [ink-law row: gen_54 credit 48:15's dotted-letters rule cashing at its equal-count edge; the ivory-tower neck proof]
Bereshit Rabbah 78:10

F — the grace-census: grace heard for ELEVEN tribes ("the children God GRACED your servant") but not Benjamin — his grace deferred to JOSEPH'S mouth at 43:29 ("God be gracious to you, my son") [the missing-grace found]; and JOSEPH SCREENS RACHEL: "this wicked one's eye is covetous" — he stood tall and hid her (ben porat ALEI AYIN decoded: the fruitful son OVER THE EYE); "I must repay you for that eye" [the screening's reward engine — wires rows 12/14]
Bereshit Rabbah 78:12

F — "as one sees the face of elohim": ELOHIM = JUDGES — and the empty-hands rule transposed ("none appear before ME empty" → none before YOU); "the gift that WAS BROUGHT to you" (hubat — it came on its own; my toil against your windfall); "HE URGED HIM AND HE TOOK" — seeming to withdraw, the hand outstretched (the grovel-for-silver verse); Rabbeinu's knife-and-bowl case (Reish Lakish's rule: TAKE NOTHING AND YOU GIVE NOTHING — the imperial messenger takes the coveted knife); and THE RETURNED-GIFTS TRADITION: all these gifts the nations are destined to RETURN to the messianic king ("the kings of Tarshish… will RETURN tribute" — yashivu not yavi'u) — said by an unnamed commoner and adopted BY NAME ("as you live, I will say it in your name") [the gift's eschatological ledger + the say-it-in-his-name etiquette recorded]
Bereshit Rabbah 78:13

F — "the children are tender": Moses and Aaron / David and Solomon (two readings); "the nursing flocks upon me" = ISRAEL; "drive them hard ONE DAY and all the flocks die" — Hadrian's day, Haman's day, survived only by His mercy [the convoy-pace verse as survival policy]
Bereshit Rabbah 78:14

F — the partnership refusal ("shall we be partners in your world? — PASS, my lord"); le-itti = slowly / with covered face; and THE SEIR AUDIT: "we searched all Scripture — Jacob NEVER went to Seir. Is the truthful one a deceiver? WHEN does he come? IN THE FUTURE: 'saviors will ascend Mount Zion to judge the mountain of Esau'" (R. Abbahu, Obadiah 1:21) [the unpaid promise resolved eschatologically — the chain auditing the patriarch's word and finding it payable, not false]
Bereshit Rabbah 78:15

Bereshit Rabbah 78:16

F — the SUKKOT CLOCK: eighteen months (booths-house-booths, R. Abba) + six months at Beit El; the gift renewed — months (R. Berekhya) or NINE YEARS (R. Avun, second seat); the libations never ceased at Beit El — "who knows their count could compute the waters of Tiberias" [numeric row; the itinerary's own chronology]
Bereshit Rabbah 79:6

F — VA-YIḤAN three ways: he GRACED the city's face (gifts to its leaders); he set up MARKETS AND SOLD CHEAP — "a man must show gratitude to the place he benefits from" [the GRATITUDE-TO-PLACE law]; and the R. SHIMON BEN YOḤAI NARRATIVE in full: thirteen years in the cave on withered carobs; the hunted-bird omen ("without Heaven no bird is taken — a man's soul all the more"); PURIFYING TIBERIAS by mandrake-cuttings (the dead rise where the cutting floats, the city mapped pure and impure); the Samaritan's PLANTED CORPSE and the decree ("the one above shall descend, the one below shall ASCEND"); Nakai the scribe mocking — "you breached the FENCE OF THE SAGES: 'one who breaches a fence, the serpent bites him'" — and became a pile of bones; the Sabbatical-gleaner ("do my colleagues not dispute me?") bitten by the same verse [the fence-breach doctrine enforced twice — quorum law: "you were not in the count with us"]; the third parse: entered at Shabbat dusk and FIXED BOUNDARIES — "Jacob kept Shabbat before it was given" [credit 11:7 at home]
Bereshit Rabbah 79:8

F — THE ALTAR-NAMING AUDACITY (33:20): Reish Lakish reads "he called it El, God of Israel" as Jacob claiming "You are God of the heavenly — and I am the ruler of the earthly"; Rav Huna's rebuke: "even a synagogue BEADLE does not take authority for himself — TOMORROW YOUR DAUGHTER GOES OUT" (va-tetze Dina priced against the self-title) [the self-authority sin; Onkelos dissolves the naming into worship — O2 dual; wires gen_57]
Bereshit Rabbah 80:8

F — (its home is ch 34, read here at its link seat): "answered WITH GUILE?" — "what do you think, deceit? THE DIVINE SPIRIT SAYS: because he had defiled Dina their sister" [the narrator's own justification clause]; FORESKIN = DISGRACE sourced from OUR 34:14 (R. Neḥemya's where-do-we-find); "their livestock and property" — they thought to despoil AND WERE DESPOILED; the Magbai joke ("Shekhem marries and Magbai gets circumcised?") [the city's grumbling recorded]
Bereshit Rabbah 90:4

F — terse: Tzafenat Paneaḥ letter-table; and the screening REPAID: "you hid your mother from the eye and stood tall — I will repay and ELEVATE you" (Joseph thirty, standing before Pharaoh) [row 3's engine, second seat]
Bereshit Rabbah 92:5

F — terse: ask-of-the-living etiquette (the Babylonian's "your mother inquired after you"); Benjamin's grace delivered at 43:29 (row 3's deferral cashed); the goblet-seating theater; Benjamin's five gifts; the twenty-two-years no-wine claim [numeric rider]
Bereshit Rabbah 98:18

F — terse: ben porat four-way (broke-faith / brothers broke faith / defied his mistress / she turned on him); the king's daughters casting jewelry from the walls — HE DID NOT LOOK — repaid: the daughters of Tzelofḥad's PORTION in the Torah [the guarded eye repaid in canon text; row 3's engine, third seat]

mat: Bereshit Rabbah 80:2

F — the Hosea 6:9 frame: like waylaying ROBBERS? — no: "like a COMPANY OF PRIESTS at the threshing floor" (the astonished upgrade — entitled, not predatory): "it was PROPER for Simeon and Levi to have killed in Shekhem"; "shall he treat our sister as ownerless?"; who caused it — va-tetze [the chain's own verdict oscillating between robbery and priesthood]
Bereshit Rabbah 80:3

F — terse: the THISTLE-AND-CEDAR parable mapped (II Kings 14:9): Ḥamor the thistle, Jacob the cedar, "give your daughter to my son" — and the beast of the field tramples [the dynastic mismatch framed]
Bereshit Rabbah 80:7

Elazar's rule: Israel never puts its finger first into the idolater's mouth — THEY demanded first (against the standing ban); mohar/matan = dowry and addition [marriage-payment vocabulary at its seat]
Bereshit Rabbah 80:9

F — THE THIRD-DAY DANGER SUGYA quoted whole at OUR 34:25 ("on the third day, when they were IN PAIN"): the recorded cluster on bathing the circumcised child on Shabbat — bathes-the-CHILD vs bathes-the-CIRCUMCISION (R. Yosei's proof from the oil-and-hot-water-on-wounds rule: the child's whole body, unlike an adult's wound); R. Elazar ben Azarya's third-day-on-Shabbat allowance; the midwives standing-instructed ("whatever you do on weekdays, do on Shabbat on the third day"); SHMUEL: BECAUSE OF DANGER — OUR VERSE IS THE MEASURE of the third day's peril; R. Yehoshua ben Levi: no prohibition here — permitted [a full testing-shelf sugya running INTO the reading: the verse as the danger-rule's source]
Bereshit Rabbah 80:10

F — "the two SONS OF JACOB, Simeon and Levi": sons who took counsel NEITHER from Jacob NOR from each other; "DINA'S BROTHERS" — named hers because they RISKED THEMSELVES for her (the naming-by-devotion rule: Miriam called Aaron's sister, Kozbi called her nation's) [a naming law with three cases]; THIRTEEN YEARS OLD (R. Elazar's number on "each man his sword"); "came upon the city CONFIDENTLY" = confident in the ELDER'S strength — and Jacob, opposed to the deed, STOOD AT THE GATE with sword and bow ("shall I let my sons fall into the nations' hands?") — the seat of 48:22's "which I took with my sword and my bow" [the father's after-the-fact guard; Onkelos moves the confidence to the city — O5 dual]
Bereshit Rabbah 80:11

Yudan); Rav Huna's hard rule on parting; her cry — "and I, where will I carry my shame?" — answered: SIMEON TOOK HER (Shaul son of THE CANAANITE WOMAN = Dina's son — with the three parses of "Canaanite": acted-Canaanite / the Ḥivite-within-Canaan / the Rabbis: Simeon BURIED her in Canaan) [the aftermath's marriage-and-burial dispute]
Bereshit Rabbah 80:12

F — THE BARREL EXCHANGE at 34:30-31: Jacob — "the barrel was CLEAR and you MUDDIED it" (the Canaanite tradition rider: "they are destined to fall into my hand — but only at 600,000"); the sons — "the barrel was MUDDIED and WE CLARIFIED it"; "shall he treat our sister as a harlot?" [the two-barrels dispute — the moral verdict recorded OPEN, both sentences preserved; the block's crown dual]
Bereshit Rabbah 97:6

F — terse: the redeemer's THREE SIGNS (anokhi, elders, pakod — the deathbed cipher); shekhem-portion parses — the birthright + Adam's garment taken from "the Emorite" = ESAU (deeds-of-the-Emorite), or literal Shekhem from Ḥamor (the Ḥivite within the Emorite); "with my sword and bow" = MITZVOT AND GOOD DEEDS vs the literal gate-stand [row 5's second seat]

mat: Bereshit Rabbah 92:2
